service_client.tooltip: Defined by the project. To change it, move this work item to a project of the intended client.

service_log.title: Work log
service_log.empty_description: Log the time spent on this work item so it can be billed to the client.
service_log.disabled: Time tracking is off for this project
service_log.disabled_description: A project admin can switch it on in the project settings.

totals.logged_hint: Chronological time, including entries that are not charged.
totals.equivalent_hint: After the hour type multiplier. This is the figure the client sees.
totals.debited_hint: Excludes entries whose billing type does not charge, such as warranty or courtesy.
totals.amount_hint: The billed value of this work item, summed from the value stored on each work log. Hours paid from a contract pool or an allowance contribute nothing.

form.entry_mode: How do you want to enter the time?
form.duration_invalid: That is not a time we can read. Try 1h 15min, 1,5h or 90min.
form.interval_required: Enter both a start and an end time

form.worked_on_hint: The day the work happened, which is the month it is billed to.
form.worked_on_future: The date of service cannot be in the future
form.description_placeholder: Describe the work. The client reads this.

preview.rounded: Rounded to {value} — this project bills in 15 minute blocks.

delete.description: This removes the logged time from the work item and from the client's total. This cannot be undone.
delete.description_batch: This entry was split into {count} parts, and all of them will be removed. This cannot be undone.

errors.time_tracking_disabled: Time tracking is off for this project.

client.title: Work log
client.consumed_hint: Hours counted against your contract. Work outside business hours counts at a higher rate, which is why this can exceed the elapsed time.
client.charged_hint: Excludes work that is not charged, such as warranty or courtesy.
client.amount_hint: Billed separately from your contract, because this work fell outside its scope.

service_allowance.title: Work item hour allowance
service_allowance.title_hint: Hours sold for this work item, isolated from the client's support contract. Work logs here consume this allowance and never the monthly pool.
service_allowance.inherited: Inherited from the parent work item. These hours belong to the parent project, not to this item.

form.title: Credit hours to this work item
form.description: Creates an allowance for this work item. Work logs on it will consume these hours instead of the client's monthly support pool.
form.description_top_up: Adds to the existing allowance. The previous credits are kept, and the balance is the sum of all of them.
form.hours_invalid: Enter a number of hours greater than zero.

alerts.negative_balance: The allowance is overrun. The work logs were recorded and the excess does not touch the client's support contract; settle it by crediting more hours or billing the overage.
alerts.high_consumption: The allowance is nearly spent. Agree a scope addendum before it goes negative.

errors.closed: This allowance is closed. A closed allowance accepts no more hours and no more work logs.

credited.title: Hours credited
credited.message: The allowance balance has been updated.

not_credited.title: Hours not credited
not_credited.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

service_overage.title: Bill the overage
service_overage.description: The hours beyond the pool will be billed at the rate below.
service_overage.irreversible: This cannot be undone. There is no reversal for a billed overage.
service_overage.no_rate: No hour rate resolves for this overage: the contract has none and the client has no price in force. Register a price, or close the period carrying the deficit instead.

toasts.failed: The overage could not be billed.
